items.title: Live: Herzog says visit 'very emotional' as PM and Israeli president speak at parliament house
items.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog is welcomed to Canberra as protesters gather on the lawns outside Parliament House. Follow live.

items.title: Woman kills nine in shootings at school and house in Canada
items.description: The woman turned the weapon on herself after the killings, according to police.

items.title: Former Victoria's Secret boss redacted from Epstein files' co-conspirators list before publish
items.description: US politician Ro Khanna has publicly named six men whose identities were scrubbed from the Epstein files, including the former boss of Victoria's Secret, who the FBI suspected was a co-conspirator of the sex offender's crimes.

items.title: Children at 'imminent' kidnapping risk by man who built secret loft in his home
items.description: WA Police say "something terrible" could have happened if there was a delay in intercepting a Baldivis man who planned to abduct and sexually abuse a child in Perth.

items.title: Telstra to axe up to 650 roles in mass redundancy round
items.description: Telstra notifies staff of plans to outsource hundreds of jobs to an India-based technology company.

items.title: Sydney Water has no fast solution to stop faecal-filled debris balls washing up on beaches
items.description: The debris balls that have washed up on NSW beaches in recent years are likely to continue as Sydney Water admits a massive fatberg it cannot reach is clogging sewers.

items.title: Liberals plot mass resignations, paving way for leadership challenge
items.description: Liberals are bracing for a wave of frontbench resignations as soon as Wednesday to pave the way for Angus Taylor to mount a leadership challenge against Sussan Ley.

items.title: Emergency warning issued for grassfire north of Melbourne
items.description: Residents near Sunbury, north of Melbourne, are advised to shelter now as a grassfire burns out of control.

items.title: The only Olympic sport that doesn't let women compete starts tonight
items.description: Nordic Combined is the only sport at any Olympic Games — summer and winter — that does not have an event for women. It's an omission that is putting the entire future of the sport at risk.

items.title: Person detained in relation to Nancy Guthrie disappearance
items.description: Law officials in Arizona say a person has been detained for questioning in relation to the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, the 84-year-old mother of Today show host Savannah.

items.title: 'How dare you': The 29-year career behind this former cop's viral DV lecture
items.description: Years on the front line of domestic violence surfaced in a frustration-filled moment on national television for Vincent Hurley. He explains what motivates him to keep fighting for change.

items.title: ASX 200 rallies as CBA surges, Aussie dollar above 71 US cents — as it happened
items.description: The Australian share market has finished strongly after the first "big day" of reporting season with good earnings news for the Commonwealth Bank for the first half of the financial year. Look back on our live blog.

items.title: No body-camera footage of woman's death in police stand-off, coroner hears
items.description: A court hears a NSW inquest will need to rely on eyewitness accounts of the 2023 death of Krista Kach, who was shot with a beanbag round following a 10-hour stand-off with police in 2023.

items.title: New engines, no DRS and other important changes to Formula 1 in 2026
items.description: New engines, new regulations and an 11-team grid are just some of the changes in Formula 1 this season. Get up to speed with what is new in F1 ahead of the Australian Grand Prix.

items.title: Hobart Cup result under investigation after course 37 metres short
items.description: The Hobart Cup, the "feature" event in Tasmania's horse racing calendar, is under investigation after the race was run over a distance found later to be 37 metres short of its advertised length.

items.title: Carlton AFL legend Peter Dean suffers fractured skull in assault
items.description: Former AFL player Peter Dean is recovering in hospital after he sustained serious head and facial injuries in an alleged assault at Albury on the New South Wales Victorian border.

items.title: The Muppet 50th birthday special makes the case for a new season
items.description: Kermit, Miss Piggy and the rest of the crew are back to celebrate their 50th birthday with a one-off special that has the potential to turn into a whole new series for the beloved characters.

items.title: As Epstein spotlight shifts to UK, Trump could have 3 million reasons to worry
items.description: Donald Trump's enemies made no secret of their hopes the documents would contain something explosive enough to bring the president down, but right now the Epstein spotlight is on Britain's politicians and palaces.

items.title: Two more Chinese nationals accused of foreign interference
items.description: A task force investigated the alleged covert collection of information about a Canberra Buddhist association.

items.title: Dinosaur bones discovered during dig in Victoria's south-east
items.description: A collection of more than 60 dinosaur bones and fossils are unearthed from rocks at the site of a fossil dig in Victoria's south-east.

items.title: Here's what's really causing millions of mortgage borrowers grief
items.description: It may sound boring, but "capacity constraints" are to blame for your higher mortgage repayments.

items.title: Adelaide aquatic centres close for cleaning after cluster of gastro cases
items.description: SA Health is urging people with gastroenteritis symptoms not to visit public swimming pools after eight cases at one swimming centre, including one child who was hospitalised and another who also visited the Adelaide Aquatic Centre.

items.title: Victorian government defends action on construction sector amid CFMEU allegations
items.description: The Victorian government is defending its handling of corruption in the state's construction sector amid accusations in a major corruption report that it was "cowed" by the CFMEU.

items.title: SA Police issue public call-out for debris from triple fatal Goolwa plane crash
items.description: Police are calling for anyone who finds wreckage from a plane crash near the Murray Mouth last week to bring the items to the Victor Harbor police station or to call them.

items.title: WA farmers count cost of strong winds but welcome rain
items.description: The Bureau of Meteorology says a weather system influenced by ex-Tropical Cyclone Mitchell delivered storms to the Great Southern and central Wheatbelt this week.
